text: Shipped 0.1 after ~29 s of holding W from the start (33 m). Banner 'Shipped 0.1. New module: search.' is clear; users 10->50, modules 6->7. Controls help bar appeared at the bottom at this moment.
In first-person view (V) the floating terrace labels '0.2' / '0.3' render through the boulder and overlap the module prompt text under the crosshair (see also f080: 'pa0s2r' / 'patch0.3').

Open issue says 'search: flaky test' but nothing on screen tells me which coloured patch of the boulder is 'search'. I have to sweep the crosshair over each patch and read the label; the patches are large, similar dark colours, and the label sometimes does not match the colour under the crosshair.

While I stood still looking around in first-person (V) on the slope, the boulder silently rolled all the way back to the 0.1 terrace. No message said so; 'Next release' jumped 16 m -> 28 m and the boulder was out of view. I spent ~3 min of turning around to find it (it was below the crest). A 'the boulder rolls back' message or an off-screen boulder indicator would help.

Patching works: holding E on auth (expiring certificate, 83%) jumped it to 'auth: healthy (100%)' within ~2 s and the green patch turned teal. But the 'Patching [###....]' bar keeps filling after the module already reads 100%, so I could not tell when patching was actually done.

Stale patch bar: 'Patching [######......]' stays under the crosshair label long after I released E (and after walking away and coming back), even though I am not patching. Expected it to revert to 'Hold E to patch'.

Aimed the crosshair at 'search: flaky test' (n0) and held E for 3 s; the boulder rolled/turned under the crosshair during the hold and the patch went to 'ui' (already healthy) instead. search stayed at 57%. Also earlier (aimmismatch.png) the 'search' label showed while the crosshair was visually over the sky/ground beside the boulder, not on the boulder.

Second patch succeeded only after sweeping the camera through a full circle in over-the-shoulder view and catching 'search' under the crosshair (~4 min of hunting for one module). Holding E ~4 s took search 55% -> 100% and immediately a new issue appeared: 'core: deprecated API'.

Re-engaging the boulder after it rolled back to the 0.1 terrace is very hard in the over-the-shoulder view: the crosshair is off-centre and the character walks straight past the boulder. Over ~8 minutes and 5 attempts (look, walk, strafe, push) I never got it moving uphill again; each 'hold w' sent me past it onto the grass. 'Next release 0.2: 27 m' never changed.

Final state at ~33 min: version 0.1, 50 users, 7 modules, health 85%, one open issue (core: deprecated API 58%), boulder still on the 0.1 terrace 27 m below the 0.2 release. Stopping to stay within budget.
